developers.name: Aldar Properties
developers.summary: An ADX-listed Abu Dhabi property group developing and managing master-planned communities across Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island.
description: Aldar Properties PJSC is a real estate developer and asset manager headquartered in Abu Dhabi and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. The company organises its activities around two core businesses: Aldar Development, which plans and builds residential and mixed-use communities, and Aldar Investment, which holds and operates a portfolio of commercial, retail, hospitality and education assets.

Its development arm works from a land bank of roughly 65 million square metres and concentrates on several of the capital's best-known destinations, including Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island. Alongside its own projects, the group manages government housing and infrastructure programmes on a fee basis through Aldar Projects, and runs separate platforms for new ventures and for mixed-use development in Egypt. Its circular headquarters tower on Al Raha Beach has become one of the more recognisable buildings on the Abu Dhabi skyline.
areas: Government housing and infrastructure delivery (Aldar Projects)

projects.name: Louvre Abu Dhabi Residences

projects.name: Gardenia Bay

projects.name: Noya

projects.name: Gate Towers and Arc Towers

developers.name: Modon
developers.summary: An Abu Dhabi-based, ADX-listed holding company whose real estate arm is master-developing Hudayriyat Island alongside projects on Reem Island.
description: Modon Holding is a diversified group headquartered in Abu Dhabi and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. It took its current name in 2024, when the listed Q Holding absorbed Modon Properties, ADNEC Group and related assets and rebranded as Modon. Its activities now span real estate, hospitality, events and tourism, asset and investment management, and urban infrastructure.

In residential property, Modon's most significant undertaking is Hudayriyat Island, where it is creating a series of waterfront and hillside neighbourhoods around public leisure facilities such as cycling and mountain-bike trails, beach areas and sports venues. The group is also active on Reem Island and elsewhere in the capital, and it operates or manages destinations including Al Mugheirah Bay, Marsana and the Bab Al Nojoum resorts, as well as projects outside the UAE. According to the company, its residential projects in investment zones such as Hudayriyat Island and Al Reem Island are offered on a freehold basis to buyers of all nationalities.

projects.name: Wadeem Gardens

projects.name: Tara Park
projects.description: An apartment community on Reem Island built around landscaped podiums and walkable open spaces, opposite Reem Mall and close to Al Fay Park.

developers.name: Bloom Holding
developers.summary: An Abu Dhabi developer and services group, part of National Holding, best known for the Bloom Living community in Zayed City and the Bloom Gardens neighbourhood.
description: Bloom Holding is an Abu Dhabi-based group that combines property development with education, hospitality, landscaping and facilities management. It forms part of the National Holding group, and its offices are at Bloom Central on Airport Road. The company has been active in the capital since the late 2000s, with a portfolio that now includes gated villa communities, mixed-use buildings and serviced residences in Abu Dhabi, as well as projects in Dubai and Al Ain.

Its largest residential undertaking is Bloom Living in Zayed City, a Spanish- and Mediterranean-inspired community planned across about 2.2 million square metres with more than 4,500 homes, a town centre, parks and schools, released over successive phases. Earlier work includes Bloom Gardens on the Eastern Mangrove Corniche, the Soho Square and Park View buildings on Saadiyat Island, and Bloom Marina at Al Bateen. Through Bloom Education, the group is also linked to several international schools in the UAE.

projects.name: Bloom Gardens

projects.name: Aldhay

projects.name: Soho Square

projects.name: Park View

projects.name: Bloom Marina

developers.name: Reportage Group
developers.summary: An Abu Dhabi-headquartered developer founded in 2014, building apartment and community projects on Reem, Yas and Saadiyat islands and in Masdar City, with a growing international footprint.
description: Reportage Group, also known as Reportage Properties, is a real estate developer founded in 2014 and headquartered in Abu Dhabi. It builds both residential apartment buildings and residential communities, and has expanded from its home market into a wide range of countries; its website currently lists 19, spanning the Gulf, Africa, Europe, Asia and the United States.

In Abu Dhabi, the company has concentrated on the capital's main growth districts. Its work includes high-rise residences on Al Reem Island, canal-side projects in the Yas Bay area of Yas Island, low-rise sustainable buildings in Masdar City and a newer development on Saadiyat Island. The portfolio is presented in two lines, residential apartments and residential communities, and the group also markets projects elsewhere in the UAE, including Dubai and Fujairah, as well as in Riyadh. Taken together, its Abu Dhabi projects lean towards mid-rise and high-rise apartment living in established island and sustainability-led districts.

projects.name: Marlin Icon
projects.description: A canal-facing residential building on Al Reem Island with one- to four-bedroom homes, including duplex units, designed with soft, curving architectural forms.

projects.name: The District
projects.description: A vertical, mixed-use community on Al Reem Island that places offices, a medical centre, a hypermarket and fitness facilities alongside its residential towers.

projects.name: Selina Bay
projects.description: A canal-side collection of apartments and townhouses near the Yas Bay waterfront and the island's leisure attractions.

projects.name: Sensi
projects.description: A newer Reportage residential project on Saadiyat Island, positioned around the island's beaches and cultural institutions.

projects.name: Oasis Residences 2
projects.description: A six-storey building of 304 apartments, including duplex layouts, located at the centre of Masdar City next to My City Centre Masdar.

projects.name: Sila
projects.description: A residential concept shaped by Masdar City's low-carbon, walkable planning principles, linking homes with landscaped public spaces.
